{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''spy ship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used for [[Spy/Legends|spying]].

During the expedition to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], at least one such vessel was part of the ''[[Admiral Korvin]]''{{'s}} complement of small craft. [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] sent down the [[Blood Carver]] [[Ke Daiv]] and an accompanying [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the two-passenger ship with banked engine flares to survey the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="RoguePlanet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] many spy ships were employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to gather intelligence on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity.<ref name="Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
